text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I messed up! It really sucks getting
injured...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But not like it's crazy painful or
anything. I can
get back to training,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? But I'm not. I'm saying I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Scaredy-cat much? I told you I'm fine.
choice_data_list: Then let's take it easy and give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?! That's what you mean by rest?
choice_data_list: We'll focus on classroom study until your injury heals.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Or, to put it another way, you're saying
the only
way to get me studying is when
I can't move,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, pal! No way am I studying! I'll
be back on
the track in no time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan rests up and lets her injury
heal
properly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! See, you get it! Wanna head to
the track?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Crap... I guess... maybe it does still hurt.
You
gotta be kidding me. What a joke...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's not quite ready to get
back to
training. She needs to focus on
her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, how's this? No complaints,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're so stubborn. As if I could be
reckless even
if I wanted to with you
watching over me like a
hawk.
choice_data_list: Let's keep going. Just don't push yourself too hard.
Let's keep going. Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Meh. I guess that's reassuring or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan makes a full
recovery.
